theory CPS

CPS / double negation

Continuation monad, algebraic laws, Kleisli composition, and constructive double-negation embedding.

Continuation-passing style as a double-negation translation.

`Cont(A; R) = (A → R) → R` is the type of computations of `A` in continuation-passing style with answer type `R`. Taking `R = False` recovers double negation: `Cont(A; False) = ¬¬A`.

This theory formalizes: 1. The continuation monad: return, bind, Kleisli composition, and monad laws (left identity, associativity, Kleisli associativity). 2. The Kolmogorov / Gödel–Gentzen double-negation translation of constructive logic, including connectives and constructive irrefutability of LEM. 3. Call-by-value CPS function types and compositional pipeline.

21 theorems, 7 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

examples/cps.nuprl

Original source file
-- | Continuation-passing style as a double-negation translation.
--
-- `Cont(A; R) = (A → R) → R` is the type of computations of `A` in
-- continuation-passing style with answer type `R`. Taking `R = False`
-- recovers double negation: `Cont(A; False) = ¬¬A`.
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. The continuation monad: return, bind, Kleisli composition, and monad laws
--    (left identity, associativity, Kleisli associativity).
-- 2. The Kolmogorov / Gödel–Gentzen double-negation translation of constructive
--    logic, including connectives and constructive irrefutability of LEM.
-- 3. Call-by-value CPS function types and compositional pipeline.
theory CPS

comment book "Continuation monad, algebraic laws, and constructive double-negation embedding."

abs DN(A) == ¬¬A
abs Cont(A; R) == (A → R) → R
abs CReturn(x) == λk. k x
abs CBind(m; f) == λk. m (λx. f x k)
abs Kleisli(f; g) == λx. CBind(f x; g)
abs Stable(A) == ¬¬A → A

soft DN, Cont, CReturn, CBind, Kleisli, Stable

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The continuation monad: typing
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Return: `a ↦ λk. k a`. At `R = False` this is `A → ¬¬A`.
theorem cont_return :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}. A → Cont(A; R)
proof
  intro A
  intro R
  intro a
  intro k
  elim 4 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

-- Bind / map-continuation. At `R = False` this is `(A → ¬¬B) → ¬¬A → ¬¬B`.
theorem cont_bind :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
    (A → Cont(B; R)) → Cont(A; R) → Cont(B; R)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro R
  intro f
  intro ca
  intro k
  elim 5 with (λa. f a k) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 8 with k THENL [hyp, hyp]],
    hyp
  ]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Continuation monad: algebraic laws
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem cont_left_unit :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
  ∀x:A. ∀f:(A → Cont(B; R)). ∀k:(B → R).
    CBind(CReturn(x); f) k = f x k ∈ R
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro R
  intro x
  intro f
  intro k
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem cont_assoc :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
  ∀m:Cont(A; R). ∀f:(A → Cont(B; R)). ∀g:(B → Cont(C; R)). ∀k:(C → R).
    CBind(CBind(m; f); g) k = CBind(m; (λx. CBind(f x; g))) k ∈ R
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro R
  intro m
  intro f
  intro g
  intro k
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem kleisli_assoc :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀D:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
  ∀f:(A → Cont(B; R)). ∀g:(B → Cont(C; R)). ∀h:(C → Cont(D; R)).
  ∀x:A. ∀k:(D → R).
    Kleisli(Kleisli(f; g); h) x k = Kleisli(f; (λy. Kleisli(g; h) y)) x k ∈ R
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro D
  intro R
  intro f
  intro g
  intro h
  intro x
  intro k
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem kleisli_left_id :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
  ∀f:(A → Cont(B; R)). ∀x:A. ∀k:(B → R).
    Kleisli((λa. CReturn(a)); f) x k = f x k ∈ R
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro R
  intro f
  intro x
  intro k
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Double-negation translation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem dni :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → ¬¬A
proof
  intro A
  lemma cont_return [A, False] THEN hyp
qed

theorem dn_map :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → B) → ¬¬A → ¬¬B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro nna
  intro nb
  elim 4 with (λa. nb (f a)) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 3 with x THENL [hyp, elim 5 with y THENL [hyp, elim 8]],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem dn_bind :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → ¬¬B) → ¬¬A → ¬¬B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  lemma cont_bind [A, B, False] THEN hyp
qed

-- `¬¬¬A → ¬A` is constructive (unlike `¬¬A → A`).
theorem triple_neg :
  ∀A:U{i}. ¬¬¬A → ¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro nnn
  intro a
  lemma dni [A] THEN elim 4 with a THENL [hyp, elim 2 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem stable_from_em :
  ∀A:U{i}. (A ∨ ¬A) → Stable(A)
proof
  intro A
  intro em
  intro nna
  elim 2 THENL [hyp, elim 3 with v THENL [hyp, elim 5]]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Double-negation translation of connectives
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem dn_and_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬¬A → ¬¬B → ¬¬(A ∧ B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro nna
  intro nnb
  intro n
  cut (A → False) as kA THENL [
    intro a THEN elim 4 with (λb. n (<a, b>)) THENL [
      eq THEN elim 5 with (<a, x>) THENL [split THENL [hyp, hyp], hyp],
      hyp
    ],
    elim 3 with kA THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

theorem dn_and_elim_left :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬¬(A ∧ B) → ¬¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  intro na
  elim 3 with (λab. let <u, v> = ab in na u) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 5 THEN elim 4 with u THENL [hyp, hyp],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem dn_and_elim_right :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬¬(A ∧ B) → ¬¬B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  intro nb
  elim 3 with (λab. let <u, v> = ab in nb v) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 5 THEN elim 4 with v THENL [hyp, hyp],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem dn_or_left :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬¬A → ¬¬(A ∨ B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro nna
  intro n
  elim 3 with (λa. n (inl a)) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 4 with (inl x) THENL [left THEN hyp, hyp],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem dn_or_right :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬¬B → ¬¬(A ∨ B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro nnb
  intro n
  elim 3 with (λb. n (inr b)) THENL [
    eq THEN elim 4 with (inr x) THENL [right THEN hyp, hyp],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem dn_implies :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → ¬¬B) → ¬¬A → ¬¬B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  lemma dn_bind [A, B] THEN hyp
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Irrefutability of excluded middle (constructive)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem lem_irrefutable :
  ∀A:U{i}. ¬¬(A ∨ ¬A)
proof
  intro A
  intro n
  elim 2 with (inr (λa. n (inl a))) THENL [
    eq THEN eq THEN elim 2 with (inl x) THENL [eq THEN hyp, hyp],
    hyp
  ]
qed

theorem kolmogorov_em :
  ∀A:U{i}. DN(A ∨ ¬A)
proof
  lemma lem_irrefutable THEN hyp
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CBV function CPS: `A → (B → R) → R`
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

abs CBVArr(A; B; R) == A → Cont(B; R)

soft CBVArr

theorem cbv_id :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}. CBVArr(A; A; R)
proof
  intro A
  intro R
  intro a
  intro k
  elim 4 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem cbv_compose :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀R:U{i}.
    CBVArr(B; C; R) → CBVArr(A; B; R) → CBVArr(A; C; R)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro R
  intro g
  intro f
  intro a
  intro k
  elim 6 with a THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 9 with (λb. g b k) THENL [
      eq THEN elim 5 with x THENL [hyp, elim 11 with k THENL [hyp, hyp]],
      hyp
    ]
  ]
qed
